component.name: Blu-ray Java (BD-J) menus for mpv
component.summary: Java runtime and libbluray JARs for Blu-ray BD-J menus

description.p: Provides an OpenJDK 17 JRE and libbluray BD-J JAR files so mpv can display Blu-ray Java (BD-J) interactive menus. Install this optional extension alongside io.mpv.Mpv.
Initial BD-J extension matching libbluray 1.5.0 in io.mpv.Mpv.
